name: Minook and the Brainbots: Collector Card Battle
detailed_description:
Get ready to enter a universe of bubblegum-powered brilliance, brain-bot battles, and digital danger! Minook and the Brainbots: Collector Card Battle is a fast-paced, strategy-packed, intergalactic collectible card game based on the beloved i-Create's multimedia franchise.

Travel 10 million parsecs from Earth to Planet Namerak, home of Minook, a teenage alien scientist with a genius IQ and a knack for saving the galaxy. Minook, armed only with chewed-up bubblegum and a wealth of intelligence, created the Brainbots, a collection of 100 unique and eccentric robots, each powered by its own unique brain. Each Brainbot, ranging from electric shockers to stealth infiltrators, possesses unique abilities, personalities, and playstyles.

But Earth is in peril. The sinister Cyber Mobsters have launched a full-scale invasion of Earth’s digital infrastructure—corrupting devices, stealing data, and spreading malware faster than light. It’s up to Minook and his team of quirky Brainbots to defend Earth and stop the Cyber Mobsters before they control the world's networks and beyond!

⚡ FEATURES:

  • 100 Unique Brainbot Cards: Each with their own lore, power, and strategy—build the ultimate deck to counter the Cyber Mobsters and take control of the battlefield.

  • Strategic Card Combat: Outsmart your enemies in intense, turn-based card battles where every move counts and synergy is the key to victory.

  • Campaign Mode: Join Minook in an epic single-player journey as you travel through planets, hack into enemy networks, and face off against the most powerful Cyber Mobsters in the galaxy.

  • Online Multiplayer: Challenge players across the cosmos in head-to-head battles to prove your deck is the best in the BrainBank.

  • Evolving Narrative: Unlock upgraded card decks and hidden lore as you progress through the game, revealing more about Minook, the Brainbots, and their mission to protect Earth.

  • No Ads, No Pay-to-Win: Pure, uninterrupted gameplay—just you, your bots, and your battle strategy.

Whether you're a long-time fan of the original franchise or a newcomer ready to dive into a sci-fi world of tactical brilliance and robotic charm, Minook and the Brainbots: Card Battle is your gateway to a thrilling card battler like no other. Gather your Brainbots, build your deck, and prepare to battle for the future of Earth—and maybe even the galaxy.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64 Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-11700k or AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 - 8GB or AMD Radeon 6700 XT - 12GB.
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Sound Card: 24-bit/48,000 Hz or 24-bit/96,000 Hz sample rate
